title: AI shopping assistants now steer buying, and our store must be agent-ready
summary: 55% of shoppers use AI in discovery (NIQ); Amazon wins 59% of AI-assisted purchases and opened Alexa to merchants. Memory costs cut notebook SoC shipments ~20%; Amazon fees and ads reached $66.1B in Q3; TikTok Shop launched an app.

points.headline: AI discovery is mainstream, and Amazon is capturing the checkout
points.detail: 55% use AI in discovery (NIQ); Amazon wins 59% of AI-assisted purchases and lets merchants connect to Alexa. We should make our feeds and checkout agent-ready.

points.headline: Memory costs are shrinking notebook volumes and squeezing margins
points.detail: Memory prices cut 2026 mobile SoC shipments nearly 20%; Apple forecasts a margin drop and Samsung and SK Hynix see shortages lasting years. Plan pricing and inventory.

points.headline: Apple plans a big entry-level laptop push while AI PCs hold up
points.detail: Apple told suppliers to plan 16M MacBook Neo units in 2027, double 2026, while Intel AI PC sales grow in a shrinking market. Expect entry-level promo pressure.

points.headline: Marketplace costs rise and TikTok Shop opens a new channel
points.detail: Amazon fees and ads hit $66.1B in Q3, 96.6% of its retail sales; TikTok Shop launched a stand-alone app. We should weigh channel margins and test new ones.
